summary: Iter 245 - Slack-Webhook Setup-Wizard im Profil: All features tested successfully. Backend: 9/9 tests passed for new Slack test endpoint and regression. Frontend: All UI components verified including 5-step wizard, docs link, toggle behavior, and Test button.
seed_data_creation: Used existing demo desks for testing office-days generate.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 245 fully tested. Features verified: (1) POST /api/users/me/office-days/slack/test endpoint: Without configured URL returns 400 'Kein Slack-Webhook konfiguriert', with non-https://hooks.slack.com/ URL returns 200 with {success:false, error:'URL beginnt nicht mit https://hooks.slack.com/'}, with invalid token URL returns 200 with {success:false, error:'HTTP 404...'}, never returns 500 (failure-tolerant). (2) Frontend Profile: Wizard toggle (data-testid='office-day-slack-wizard-toggle') shows 'Anleitung anzeigen' when collapsed, '▾ Anleitung anzeigen' when expanded. Wizard panel (data-testid='slack-webhook-wizard') has 5 steps (data-testid='slack-wizard-step-1' to 'slack-wizard-step-5'), each with numbered badge, title, description, and CSS mockup. Slack docs link (data-testid='slack-wizard-docs-link') points to https://api.slack.com/messaging/webhooks with target=_blank. Test button (data-testid='office-day-slack-test') visible when slack_webhook_configured=true, shows error/success toast on click. (3) Regression: Iter 244 tests (11/11 executed) still pass - Slack-URL Privacy, Skip-Note, Skip-Reasons all working.
